root_idea.summary: The root denotes bringing something about through an act or other form of doing.
root_idea.development: Its lexical range extends from performing or producing an act to the act itself, its agent, its habitual performer, and what has been effected by an agent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct single-action verbal-noun pattern, normalized to its citation form.
Distinct verbal-noun headword, normalized from the inflected Quran form.
Distinct passive-participle headword, normalized from the inflected Quran form.

senses.definition: To do, perform, or bring about an act or matter.
senses.usage_conditions: A general Form I verb whose tense, voice, and subject are supplied by the inflection; Quranic contexts include ordinary performance, carrying out an act, and bringing something about.

senses.definition: One who does, performs, or is able to accomplish something; a doer.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction فَاعِلُونَ لِلزَّكَاةِ, it is interpreted as performing or giving zakat; in وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ, it denotes being able to do what was intended. These are constructional applications of the active-participle meaning.
Refers to one particular act, including an act characterized as good or bad; the Quranic occurrence refers to one deed previously done.

senses.definition: One who habitually, unfailingly, or intensively does or accomplishes what is willed.
senses.usage_conditions: An intensive active-participle pattern; the Quranic usage applies it to an agent characterized by persistent or unfailing accomplishment, including the phrase doing what He wills.
The Quranic occurrence is in فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ, the doing or performance of good works.

senses.definition: Done, effected, or brought about by an agent.
senses.usage_conditions: As a passive participle, it presents an act or result with reference to its agent. In Quranic contexts this can be rendered as fulfilled, accomplished, or destined, without requiring separate lexical senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do something to someone; to treat or deal with someone in a specified way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In فَعَلَ اللهُ بِهِ, it occurs as an imprecatory formula meaning, in effect, may God do to him what He will.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with بِـ; the lexical evidence supports the sexual-action meaning without making the source example's gender a general restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The scanning or metrical analysis of a verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical metonym in prosody, based on the occurrence of the root letters in the names of metrical feet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do something together or reciprocally with another agent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence presents the construction as involving two agents acting jointly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become affected or undergo the effect of an act; to be done in a quasi-passive sense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived verb can describe receiving an effect whether or not the agent intended that result; it is also used technically for passion or undergoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fabricate or forge a lie against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes the person against whom the fabrication is made and the falsehood as its object.
A substantivized passive-participial use, also extended to things described as falsified.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An original composition, especially a poem or song, not imitated from a model.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use for independently composed artistic work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vulva of a she-camel or of a female animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun distinct from the verbal-noun meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A custom, manner, habit, or habitual practice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal pattern denoting an established mode of conduct.
An archaic command form, comparable to other nouns used as imperatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good or bad conduct or acts, especially the conduct of a single person; it may include generosity or bounty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in commendation or blame and specifically associated in the evidence with one agent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A doing or action between two agents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or jointly performed action, distinct from فَعَالٌ as conduct of one agent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The handle or wooden shaft inserted into the eye of an axe, adze, or hoe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete tool noun with plural فُعُلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A metonymic name for Khuzāʿa, the well-known tribe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An onomastic and metonymic use, not a productive ordinary meaning of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A worker, especially one who works with clay, building, plastering, or digging foundations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle with a specialized occupational use; the plural فَعَلَةٌ is likewise used for such workers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grievous, distressing, or unprecedented effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic phrase جَاءَ بِالْمُفْتَعَلِ, said of an effect or experience beyond what was previously known.

cautions: The Quranic renderings “fulfilled,” “accomplished,” and “destined” under مَفْعُولٌ are contextual realizations of the broader passive-participial meaning “done or effected,” not separate lexical senses.
The interpretation of فَاعِلُونَ لِلزَّكَاةِ as those who give or perform zakat is construction-specific and does not restrict the active participle generally to zakat.
